§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English Expert

Brice Gadou is an English language specialist dedicated to building rigorous, practical training for working professionals. Lexicon reflects his belief that fluency in business is built systematically, one precise term at a time — and with this ninth volume, the alphabet is complete: nine hundred modules, A to Z.

Designed for B1–C1 professionals ready to discuss strategy, leadership, and growth with genuine command — Lexicon is more than a word list. It's the working vocabulary of modern business.
